# Waveshare AMOLED 2.06 board reference

The hardware pin assignments and CO5300 initialization parameters follow
Waveshare's ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-2.06 examples and factory BSP, revision
`3de8684cc3b27a8b6aa920157ecf399287528181`.

Copyright Waveshare. The reference repository is Apache-2.0 licensed. Its
license is included alongside this notice. Dragon Detector uses its existing
CO5300 and ES8311 drivers with their existing notices and licenses.

- https://github.com/waveshareteam/ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-2.06
- `examples/factory/components/waveshare__esp32_s3_touch_amoled_2_06/esp32_s3_touch_amoled_2_06.c`
- `examples/arduino/libraries/board_config/pin_config.h`
- https://docs.waveshare.com/ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-2.06

The FT3168 reader uses the documented FT5x06-compatible report registers.
